game.title: Batman: Arkham City - Game of the Year Edition

roadmap.title: Story and Catwoman episodes
roadmap.description: Play the main story on Normal or Hard (Easy does not unlock New Game Plus). Play Catwoman's episodes when they open and finish the story achievements.

roadmap.title: Side missions and Crime Alley
roadmap.description: Finish the side missions, the training exercises, the Crime Alley moment and the Calendar Man holidays. Side missions must also be finished again in New Game Plus.

roadmap.title: Riddler hostages and collectibles
roadmap.description: Collect Riddler trophies and riddles, rescue the five hostages, buy every upgrade and finish Catwoman's trophies, challenges and jewels.

roadmap.title: New Game Plus
roadmap.description: Start New Game Plus, finish the story and the side missions again, and use a big fight to use five Quickfire gadgets.

roadmap.title: Harley Quinn's Revenge
roadmap.description: Play the three episodes. Do the missable combat goals in a single run and pop all 30 Harley Balloons.

roadmap.title: Riddler's Revenge as Batman
roadmap.description: Do the combat achievements first, then earn all ranked and campaign medals as Batman. Perfect Knight - Day 2 unlocks last.

roadmap.title: Riddler's Revenge as Catwoman
roadmap.description: Earn the ranked and campaign medals with Catwoman.

roadmap.title: Riddler's Revenge as Robin
roadmap.description: Earn the ranked and campaign medals with Robin, including his two exclusive maps.

roadmap.title: Riddler's Revenge as Nightwing
roadmap.description: Earn the ranked and campaign medals with Nightwing, including his two exclusive maps.

achievements.description: Become the Bat
achievements.summary: Finish the prologue and collect the Bat Suit and gear on top of the Ace Chemicals building.

steps.text: Play the prologue mission Bruce Wayne Held Hostage, then collect the Bat Suit and gear on top of the @loc{Ace Chemicals} building.

achievements.description: Save the damsel, but is she in distress?
achievements.summary: Rescue Catwoman out of Two-Face's hands inside the Solomon Wayne Courthouse.

steps.text: Finish the main mission Rescue Catwoman by getting her out of @enemy{Two-Face}'s grasp at the @loc{Solomon Wayne Courthouse}.

achievements.description: Save the medical volunteers
achievements.summary: Defeat the four Thugs holding Aaron Cash and the medical volunteers hostage in the Church.

steps.text: While playing the mission Tracking Down Joker, go into the Church (also called the Medical Center), found in @loc{Park Row}, and defeat the four Thugs who hold @npc{Aaron Cash} and the volunteers.

achievements.description: There is only one way in
achievements.summary: Get into the Steel Mill via the chimney, then reach the Loading Bay by crawling through a gap.

steps.text: During the main mission The Steel Mill, go in through the chimney.
Leave the furnace room and crawl into the Loading Bay full of Thugs.

achievements.description: Hammer the point home
achievements.summary: Defeat the Mister Hammer mini-boss in the Steel Mill Loading Bay.

steps.text: Pick up the @item{Remote Electrical Charge} gadget in the Steel Mill.
Go back to the Loading Bay and defeat @enemy{Mister Hammer}.

achievements.description: Clear the airwaves
achievements.summary: Destroy the Communications Disrupter in the Subway Terminal and defeat Penguin's Thugs there.

steps.text: During the main mission Disrupt the Disrupters, destroy the first two Disrupters in Arkham City.
Go underground through the Subway to the Subway Terminal.
Defeat Penguin's Thugs and destroy the last Communications Disrupter.

achievements.description: Last man standing
achievements.summary: Defeat every wave of Penguin's men and the Titan Thug in the Museum's Gladiator Pit.

steps.text: In the @loc{Museum}, enter the Gladiator Pit room.
Beat all the waves of Penguin's men, then the @enemy{Titan Thug}.

achievements.description: Stop the unstoppable
achievements.summary: Defeat Solomon Grundy in the Iceberg Lounge.

steps.text: Take the Freeze Override disrupter upgrade from Mr. Freeze's suit in the Museum Armory.
Go to the @loc{Iceberg Lounge} and confront @npc{Penguin}.
In the @enemy{Solomon Grundy} fight, disable his electric charges and beat him down twice.

achievements.description: Uncover the secret of Arkham City
achievements.summary: Open the third door in the last room of Wonder City Avenue to enter Wonder Avenue.

steps.text: In the last room of @loc{Wonder City Avenue}, use @item{Explosive Gel} to uncover the Industrial Motor.
Open the third door and walk into Wonder Avenue.

achievements.description: We are legion
achievements.summary: Complete the Demon Trials and defeat Ra's al Ghul.

steps.text: Finish the Demon Trials in Wonder City.
Defeat @enemy{Ra's al Ghul}.

achievements.description: A deadly game of hide and seek
achievements.summary: Beat Mr. Freeze inside the GCPD Building.

steps.text: During the main mission Mr. Freeze, head into the GCPD Building (@loc{Amusement Mile}) and beat @enemy{Mr. Freeze}.

achievements.description: Fight for survival
achievements.summary: Defeat the Joker and his Thugs in the Joker's lair.

guide.context: The fight has many Thugs, so it is a good place for the Physical Challenges.

steps.text: During the main mission Protocol Ten, enter the Joker's lair.
Defeat @enemy{Joker} and his Thugs.

achievements.description: Don't look down
achievements.summary: Climb Wonder Tower and defeat Hugo Strange at the top.

steps.text: Climb @loc{Wonder Tower} all the way up during the main mission of the same name.
Defeat @enemy{Hugo Strange}.

achievements.description: All the world is a stage
achievements.summary: Finish the main story by stopping the Joker inside the Monarch Theater.

steps.text: Play the last main missions and beat the Joker inside the @loc{Monarch Theater}.

achievements.description: Stop the contract operative
achievements.summary: Take down the assassin Deadshot to finish the A Shot in the Dark side mission.

guide.context: Deadshot's three crime scenes appear over time as victims are shot. The final one only appears after the story is finished.

steps.text: Reach the first victim on the Gotham FM roof in @loc{Amusement Mile} after the Steel Mill. Set up the crime scene and follow the bullet line to the shell casing in the @loc{Industrial District}.
When you hear a gunshot, find the second body on the broken overpass above the Political Prisoner camp in north @loc{Park Row}, and scan the clues.
After the story, listen for another gunshot. Investigate the third scene on the western edge of @loc{Park Row}, by the Tyger checkpoint.
Search building 12A (not 12B or 12C). Go up the stairs, tear down the hatch at the back of the small room, and use the @item{Cryptographic Sequencer} on the PDA you find.
Reach Jack Ryder in the upper @loc{Bowery} before Deadshot kills him. You have 3 minutes, or 2 in New Game Plus. Then take Deadshot down from below.

achievements.description: Track down the serial killer
achievements.summary: Track down the killer to finish the Identity Theft side mission.

steps.text: In the @loc{Bowery}, find the body near a barrel fire in the alley beside the Arkham City Processing Center. Use the Evidence Scanner and follow the blood trail to a Political Prisoner.
After you get the @item{Line Launcher}, find the second victim in an isolated @loc{Park Row} alley and scan the scene.
Find the third victim in the alley on the south face of the @loc{Ace Chemicals} building. Scan the scene and follow the bleach trail to the Inmate who reveals the killer's hideout.
Go to the hideout (same complex as Catwoman's) and get out of the trap.

achievements.description: Reveal the mystery watcher
achievements.summary: Find the Mysterious Watcher at all five of his locations in the Watcher in the Wings side mission.

guide.context: His next location only appears as the story moves on, so this takes more than one visit.

steps.text: Find the first @npc{Mysterious Watcher} in @loc{Park Row} and scan the symbol he draws in Detective Mode.
After the Steel Mill, get to the highest point of the Ferris Wheel (@loc{Industrial District}) and scan his next symbol.
After Wonder City, interrogate Quincy Sharp in the @loc{Bowery}. Grapple to the rooftop across from you and scan the third symbol.
Find him on a rooftop beside a water tower, west of the GCPD Building (@loc{Amusement Mile}), and scan the fourth symbol.
Line up the circular emblem over all four symbols. It shows the final spot on the Church wall in @loc{Park Row}. Scan the big symbol there to meet @npc{Azrael}.

achievements.description: Destroy it all
achievements.summary: Destroy all six Titan Containers in Arkham City for Bane's Fragile Alliance side mission.

guide.context: Only two containers are reachable at first. The others open up as the main story moves on.

steps.text: Go to the @loc{Krank Co. Toys} building in @loc{Amusement Mile} and talk to @npc{Bane} to start the mission.
Destroy the container in the @loc{Industrial District} with @item{Explosive Gel}, then the one in the @loc{Bowery}.
After the Steel Mill, destroy the container behind the door at the south ground-floor entrance of the @loc{Steel Mill}.
Destroy the one in the Subway Tunnels (a few Thugs guard it), the one in the @loc{Museum} War Room, and the one on the second floor of Wonder Tower Foundations.
Return to Bane at Krank Co. Toys to finish the mission.

achievements.description: Stop the phone booth killer
achievements.summary: Defeat Victor Zsasz at his hideout to finish the Cold Call Killer side mission.

steps.text: After Rescue Catwoman, listen for a ringing payphone. Use Detective Mode to find it and answer.
Follow the waypoint to the next phone before the timer ends, and trace Zsasz's signal while he talks. Repeat for every call.
When the mission reaches 80%, go to Zsasz's hideout on the @loc{Industrial District} waterfront.
Sneak behind @enemy{Victor Zsasz} and take him down through the glass window.

achievements.description: Time is running out
achievements.summary: Defeat the Mad Hatter and his waves of Thugs in the Tea Party side mission.

steps.text: After rescuing Vicki Vale, go to the "Cure drop off point" waypoint in @loc{Park Row}.
Beat the @enemy{Mad Hatter}'s waves of Thugs.

achievements.description: Reunite the separated couple
achievements.summary: Find Nora and bring her back to Mr. Freeze to finish the Heart of Ice side mission.

steps.text: Beat Mr. Freeze inside the GCPD Building to unlock this side mission.
In the northeast @loc{Industrial District}, go to the waterfront area with two cranes. In Detective Mode, spot the door in the building on your left.
Glide to the Falcone Shipping barge and look back in Detective Mode to spot the Structural Weakness set into the wall just over the water.
Make a platform with @item{Freeze Blast}. Use the Anchor Points and @item{Batclaw} to pull yourself to the wall, blast it with @item{Explosive Gel}, and keep pulling yourself inside.
Beat the Thugs, free @npc{Nora}, and return to Mr. Freeze.

achievements.description: Complete all augmented reality training exercises
achievements.summary: Finish all 8 Augmented Reality training exercises.

guide.context: The Basic exercises unlock the Grapnel Boost, and the Advanced ones open only after the Basic set. Advanced exercise 1 is the hardest.

steps.text: Reach the Industrial District, then go to the waypoints and finish the 4 Basic gliding exercises.
Go to the waypoints for the 4 Advanced exercises and finish them.

achievements.description: Collect all of Batman's gadgets and upgrades
achievements.summary: Collect all of Batman's gadgets and buy all of his upgrades.

guide.context: Only Batman counts; Catwoman's upgrades do not.

steps.text: Finish the main story so every gadget you get from the story is collected.
Open the WayneTech tab of the PDA and buy any remaining upgrades with XP. The Tyger Master Program is the last one.

achievements.description: Stop all assaults in Arkham City
achievements.summary: Rescue Political Prisoners from all 16 assaults in Arkham City.

steps.text: Go to the western edge of @loc{Park Row} and rescue @npc{Jack Ryder} from Thugs, then talk to him.
Stop each assault on a Political Prisoner as you see it around the city. Keep track of the spots you finished.
After the story, circle the city to the remaining spots. If an assault does not appear, save, quit to the main menu, reload, and check again.

achievements.description: Solve the first riddle
achievements.summary: Solve the Riddler's first riddle in the Church.

steps.text: After leaving the GCPD Building, go to the Church in @loc{Park Row} and enter.
Walk to the rear of the Church and scan the pipe organ in Detective Mode.

achievements.description: Rescue the first hostage from Riddler
achievements.summary: Rescue the first Riddler hostage.

steps.text: Finish the Church riddle, then go to the @loc{Solomon Wayne Courthouse}. Beat the Thugs and untie M.P.T. Eddie Burlow to get the Enigma Machine.
Open the Enigma tab on the PDA and solve the riddle. The answer is "Secret".
Head to the waypoint on the Church's west side. Enter @loc{The Black Canary} through the wall bearing the green question mark, and hit the question mark over the door with a @item{Batarang}.
In the room with electrified tiles, cross from safe zone to safe zone using the question marks that switch off a path for 20 seconds. Hit the question mark on the left wall to start the lift.
Glide from the top of the lift to the hostage and free him. The achievement unlocks when he gives you the next radio code.

achievements.description: Rescue the second hostage from Riddler
achievements.summary: Rescue the second Riddler hostage.

guide.context: You need 80 Riddler Collectibles/Challenges completed to decode the second radio broadcast.

steps.text: Decode the first hostage's radio code on the @item{Cryptographic Sequencer} to get the next riddle. The answer is "Darkness".
Go to the hostage waypoint in @loc{Amusement Mile}. Enter the hideout through the wall marked with a green question mark.
In the first room, step onto the lower-floor pressure plate to start the shuffle game. In Detective Mode, the hostage is really below the containers.
Hit the question mark under the hostage with a @item{Batarang} and jump over to free him. If you fail, the hostage dies and you can retry from the game over screen.
The achievement unlocks when he gives the next radio code.

achievements.description: Rescue the third hostage from Riddler
achievements.summary: Rescue the third Riddler hostage, an unnamed doctor, in the Industrial District.

guide.context: You need 160 Riddler Collectibles/Challenges and the Line Launcher.

steps.text: Decode the second code on the @item{Cryptographic Sequencer}, then solve the riddle. The answer is "Penny".
Go to the hostage waypoint in the @loc{Industrial District}. Kick the wall near the dumpsters in the alley with the spray-painted question mark, and enter the lair.
Use the @item{Line Launcher} to reach a walkway across the water. Aim the @item{Remote Electrical Charge} at the Industrial Motors to move the water covering the two question marks.

Hit the right question mark with a @item{Batarang} and the left one with a @item{Remote Controlled Batarang}. Use the Line Launcher past the first circular saws, and fire another line to the right before the second set.
In the next room, use the Remote Electrical Charge to move a Sionis Steel Pallet onto the pressure plate, then free the doctor.

achievements.description: Rescue the fourth hostage from Riddler
achievements.summary: Rescue the fourth Riddler hostage.

guide.context: You need 240 Riddler Collectibles/Challenges to rescue this hostage.

steps.text: Type 6-0-6 1-2-0 in the @item{Cryptographic Sequencer}, then solve the riddle. The answer is "Shadow".
Go to the hostage waypoint in the @loc{Industrial District} and break into the hideout.
Use the Sequencer to open a path through the electrified floor to the safe zone. Throw a @item{Batarang} at a question mark to open another path, then climb to the second floor and cross the room.

Use the @item{Line Launcher} to enter the room left of the hostage. Destroy the Structural Weakness with @item{Explosive Gel}, then aim the @item{Remote Electrical Charge} at the Industrial Electromagnet to move a crate from the fence opening, and use a Remote Controlled Batarang to turn off the question mark.
Move onto the pressure plate of the next room, then fire the Line Launcher two times to grab the hostage in mid-air and carry him out through the glass window.

achievements.description: Rescue the fifth hostage from Riddler
achievements.summary: Rescue the fifth Riddler hostage.

guide.context: You need 320 Riddler Collectibles/Challenges to rescue this hostage.

steps.text: Enter code 1-1-5 7-8-0 into the @item{Cryptographic Sequencer}, then solve the riddle. The answer is "Mirror".
Go to the hostage waypoint in @loc{Amusement Mile} and enter the hideout.
Use each of your gadgets in turn on the small puzzles to reach and free M.P.T. Anne Bishop.

achievements.description: Rescue all the hostages from Riddler
achievements.summary: Take down the Riddler at his final hideout to finish the Enigma Conundrum side mission.

guide.context: You need 400 Riddler Collectibles/Challenges completed (Catwoman's DLC collectibles count as bonuses). Interrogating Riddler informants adds collectible locations to your map.

steps.text: Rescue the fifth hostage, then follow Oracle's tip to the waypoint just below the Iceberg Lounge entrance in the @loc{Bowery}.
Dive Bomb toward the waypoint, pull up quickly, and glide over the electrified fence. Enter the door on the other side.
Walk around the track where the kidnapped cops and medical staff walk, get below the Riddler, and perform a Takedown.

achievements.description: Obtain 24 medals on the original Arkham City maps (as Batman)
achievements.summary: Earn 24 medals on Batman's base-game ranked maps.

guide.context: Each map gives up to 3 medals. Only the original base-game maps count. The DLC and Joker's Carnival maps do not. Combat medals come from points; Predator medals come from three set takedown styles.

steps.text: Play the Combat and Predator ranked maps as Batman in Riddler's Revenge.
In Combat, keep your combo alive, stun Armored Thugs and beat them down, and use many different gadgets for variation bonuses. End rounds with a Ground Pound when possible.
In Predator, take down Thugs in the three ways the map lists for its medals. Time does not matter.
Keep playing until your total is 24 medals.

achievements.description: Obtain 48 medals on the original Arkham City maps (as Batman)
achievements.summary: Earn 48 medals on Batman's base-game ranked maps.

guide.context: Same maps and rules as the Bronze goal. This is the halfway point of the 72 medals.

steps.text: Keep earning medals on the base-game Combat and Predator ranked maps as Batman until you have 48.

achievements.description: Obtain all 72 medals on the original Arkham City maps (as Batman)
achievements.summary: Earn all 72 medals on Batman's base-game ranked maps.

guide.context: That is 36 Combat and 36 Predator medals from the base-game maps only.

steps.text: Finish the remaining Combat and Predator ranked maps as Batman with 3 medals each.

achievements.description: Obtain 36 medals on the original Arkham City campaigns (as Batman)
achievements.summary: Earn 36 medals on Batman's base-game campaigns.

guide.context: A campaign is a chain of three maps with changing modifiers. Each campaign gives up to 9 medals. The base game has 12 campaigns for 108 medals. Modifiers include Decreased Health, One Hand Tied (no counter icons or silent takedowns from behind), Gadget Malfunction (gadgets off in combat, scrambled Detective Mode in Predator) and Super Powered.

steps.text: Open the Campaign challenges as Batman in Riddler's Revenge.
Play each campaign and earn all 3 medals on each of its 3 maps. Stop when you have 36 medals, which is 4 campaigns.

achievements.description: Obtain 72 medals on the original Arkham City campaigns (as Batman)
achievements.summary: Earn 72 medals on Batman's base-game campaigns.

guide.context: This is 8 of the 12 base-game campaigns at 9 medals each.

steps.text: Keep playing the campaigns as Batman and earn all 9 medals in each until you have 72 medals, which is 8 campaigns.

achievements.description: Obtain all 108 medals on the original Arkham City campaigns (as Batman)
achievements.summary: Earn all 108 medals on Batman's base-game campaigns.

guide.context: That is all 12 base-game campaigns at 9 medals each.

steps.text: Finish the last 4 campaigns, including the Extreme ones, with all 9 medals each.

achievements.description: Complete one combat challenge without taking damage (any character)
achievements.summary: Finish one combat challenge without taking damage as any character.

guide.context: You can break your combo. Only damage matters.

steps.text: Pick Blind Justice. It has only 3 to 10 Thugs per round.
Play all 4 rounds without being hit once. Expect several tries, especially on round 4.

achievements.description: Complete New Game Plus
achievements.summary: Complete New Game Plus.

guide.context: New Game Plus only unlocks after finishing the story on Normal or Hard; Easy does not unlock it. Enemies deal and take more damage, counter icons disappear, and tougher enemies appear from the start. Difficulty carries over.

steps.text: Finish the story once on Normal or Hard, then start New Game Plus.
Play to the end and defeat @enemy{Clayface} in the @loc{Monarch Theater}. Stay defensive, bait his rolls near the exploding corners, and dodge whenever unsure.
Save your health for the last phase with his minions, and do not overuse @item{Freeze Bomb}. If you die in this fight, you restart the whole fight.

achievements.description: A moment of remembrance
achievements.summary: Pay your respects at the chalk outlines of Bruce Wayne's parents in Crime Alley.

guide.context: Batman stays crouched while the camera circles him. It takes about 5 minutes.

steps.text: Set a waypoint on the Ace Chemicals building label and walk to it. You end up outside the @loc{Monarch Theater}.
Climb the chain link fence beside the theater entrance (on its right), walk down @loc{Crime Alley}, and turn left to the chalk outlines.
Press the prompt to Pay Your Respects, then wait until the camera has circled Batman twice.

achievements.description: Have 12 murderous dates with Calendar Man
achievements.summary: Talk to Calendar Man on 12 different holidays.

guide.context: The game reads your computer's clock. You can set the date by hand instead of waiting. Mother's Day, Father's Day, Labor Day and Thanksgiving fall on different dates each year, so use the 2022 dates below. The calendar next to his cell shows which holidays you have done. Progress carries over between sessions. Save in Park Row after each talk and minimize the game. Set your computer date to the next holiday, return to the game and enter the Courthouse again so it registers the date, then go down to the basement and talk to Calendar Man. Wait for him to sit back down before you leave.

collectibles.name: New Year's Day
collectibles.location: @loc{Solomon Wayne Courthouse} basement, Calendar Man's cell
collectibles.method: Set your computer clock to January 1 and talk to @npc{Calendar Man}.

collectibles.name: Valentine's Day
collectibles.location: @loc{Solomon Wayne Courthouse} basement, Calendar Man's cell
collectibles.method: Set your computer clock to February 14 and talk to @npc{Calendar Man}.

collectibles.name: St. Patrick's Day
collectibles.location: @loc{Solomon Wayne Courthouse} basement, Calendar Man's cell
collectibles.method: Set your computer clock to March 17 and talk to @npc{Calendar Man}.

collectibles.name: April Fools' Day
collectibles.location: @loc{Solomon Wayne Courthouse} basement, Calendar Man's cell
collectibles.method: Set your computer clock to April 1 and talk to @npc{Calendar Man}.

collectibles.name: Mother's Day
collectibles.location: @loc{Solomon Wayne Courthouse} basement, Calendar Man's cell
collectibles.method: Set your computer clock to May 8, 2022 and talk to @npc{Calendar Man}.

collectibles.name: Father's Day
collectibles.location: @loc{Solomon Wayne Courthouse} basement, Calendar Man's cell
collectibles.method: Set your computer clock to June 19, 2022 and talk to @npc{Calendar Man}.

collectibles.name: Independence Day
collectibles.location: @loc{Solomon Wayne Courthouse} basement, Calendar Man's cell
collectibles.method: Set your computer clock to July 4 and talk to @npc{Calendar Man}.

collectibles.name: St. Roch's Day
collectibles.location: @loc{Solomon Wayne Courthouse} basement, Calendar Man's cell
collectibles.method: Set your computer clock to August 16 and talk to @npc{Calendar Man}.

collectibles.name: Labor Day
collectibles.location: @loc{Solomon Wayne Courthouse} basement, Calendar Man's cell
collectibles.method: Set your computer clock to September 5, 2022 and talk to @npc{Calendar Man}.

collectibles.name: Halloween
collectibles.location: @loc{Solomon Wayne Courthouse} basement, Calendar Man's cell
collectibles.method: Set your computer clock to October 31 and talk to @npc{Calendar Man}.

collectibles.name: Thanksgiving
collectibles.location: @loc{Solomon Wayne Courthouse} basement, Calendar Man's cell
collectibles.method: Set your computer clock to November 24, 2022 and talk to @npc{Calendar Man}.

collectibles.name: Christmas
collectibles.location: @loc{Solomon Wayne Courthouse} basement, Calendar Man's cell
collectibles.method: Set your computer clock to December 25 and talk to @npc{Calendar Man}.

achievements.description: Perform a perfect combo including all of Batman's combat moves (any play mode)
achievements.summary: Perform one combo that uses all 13 of Batman's combat moves in any play mode.

guide.context: The moves, in groups: Basic - Strike, Cape Stun, Evade, Counter, Aerial Attack, Batclaw Slam, Ultimate Cape Stun, Ground Takedown, Beat Down Finisher. Special - Combat Takedown, Special Combo Bat Swarm, Disarm and Destroy, Multi-Ground Takedown.

steps.text: Choose a map with endless Thugs, like the DLC Iceberg Lounge VIP Room, or round 3 of Survival of the Fittest (Extreme).
Pick a fixed order for the 13 moves and use it every time, until you land them all in one unbroken combo.

achievements.description: Use 5 different Quickfire gadgets in one fight  (any play mode)
achievements.summary: In any play mode, use five different Quickfire gadgets within a single fight.

guide.context: They do not have to be in one combo. Look in the WayneTech tab of the PDA for the Quickfire controls.

steps.text: Start a large fight in any play mode.
In that same fight, use Quickfire @item{Explosive Gel} first, once your multiplier reaches 1 or more.
Use Evade to make some room, then use Quickfire @item{Batarang}, @item{Batclaw}, @item{Remote Electrical Charge} and @item{Freeze Blast}.

achievements.description: Complete every challenge in Arkham City - Main Story, Side Missions, Upgrades, Collectables, New Game Plus and Riddlers Revenge (as Batman)
achievements.summary: Complete every challenge in Arkham City as Batman: story, side missions, upgrades, collectibles, New Game Plus and Riddler's Revenge.

guide.context: Only the side missions must be done in both the first run and New Game Plus. Upgrades, gadgets and Riddler collectibles carry over, and so do the 40 Physical Challenges.

steps.text: Finish the story once on Normal or Hard, then finish New Game Plus.
Finish all 12 side missions on the first run and again in New Game Plus.
Buy every gadget and upgrade, and complete all 400 Riddler collectibles and challenges.
Complete all 40 of Batman's Physical Challenges.
Earn all 72 ranked and all 108 campaign medals as Batman. The achievement unlocks after the last one.

achievements.description: Complete all 40 of the Catwoman Riddler grid items
achievements.summary: Complete all 40 Catwoman Riddler grid items: 35 trophies and 5 challenges.

guide.context: Catwoman Trophies are scattered around the city. Some sit in the same cages as Batman's Riddler Trophies, and some need walls Batman destroyed first. The map tracks how many you have.

steps.text: Play Catwoman's episodes and collect all 35 Catwoman Trophies. Switch to her with the cat statues in @loc{The Bowery}, @loc{Park Row} and the @loc{Industrial District} after the story.
Stun an enemy with Caltrops 3 times.
Land a Special Combo Whiplash and a Special Combo Whip Trip within one combo run. Buy both upgrades first.
Do one Claw Climb with at least 8 separate leaps without a "Too Late" jump. "Perfect" and "Good" both count.
Perform a Pounce Attack 3 times. You must be a little away from the Thug, or the prompt says Drop Attack.
Use Quickfire Whip in combat 3 times.

achievements.description: Drop in on an old friend
achievements.summary: Defeat Poison Ivy's waves of possessed Thugs in her lair to finish Catwoman Episode 2.

steps.text: After the Steel Mill main mission, play Catwoman Episode 2, then enter Poison Ivy's lair in the northeast corner of the map and defeat her waves of possessed Thugs.

achievements.description: Steal the score of a lifetime
achievements.summary: Take both briefcases from the Tyger Confiscated Goods Vault as Catwoman.

steps.text: After the Steel Mill, play Catwoman Episode 3 and get into the Tyger Confiscated Goods Vault.
Pick up the two briefcases inside.

achievements.description: Retrieve your stolen goods
achievements.summary: Recover all 16 jewels from Two-Face's Thugs as Catwoman.

guide.context: Only the Bowery and Park Row have Two-Face's Thugs. Amusement Mile and the Industrial District belong to the Joker.

steps.text: Finish Catwoman Episode 4, then use a cat statue in The Bowery, Park Row or the Industrial District to play as Catwoman.
Turn on Thief Vision and look for Thugs with a floating diamond above their heads.
Knock each of them out to get 1 jewel. Collect 16 in total.
If you cannot find more diamond Thugs, save, quit to the main menu, and reload to respawn them.

achievements.description: Obtain all 72 medals on the original Arkham City maps (as Catwoman)
achievements.summary: Earn all 72 medals on Catwoman's base-game ranked maps.

guide.context: Catwoman has no way to disable or destroy weapons, so they pile up on the ground. She cannot ride Titans. Her best tools are Whip stuns, Whip Trip and Whiplash.

steps.text: Play Catwoman in Riddler's Revenge on the base-game ranked maps, 12 Combat and 12 Predator.
Earn 3 medals on every map. In Predator, play very carefully and use Floor Grates, vents and gargoyles to move unseen. The hardest part is staying alive until the end.

achievements.description: Obtain all 108 medals on the original Arkham City campaigns (as Catwoman)
achievements.summary: Earn all 108 medals on Catwoman's base-game campaigns.

guide.context: That is all 12 base-game campaigns at 9 medals each. She has few gadgets, so her Predator maps are the hardest.

steps.text: Play all 12 base-game campaigns as Catwoman and earn 3 medals on each map.

achievements.description: Obtain 78 medals on the original Arkham City and Robin Bundle Pack maps (as Robin)
achievements.summary: Earn 78 medals on Robin's ranked maps: the base-game ones plus his Robin Bundle Pack maps.

guide.context: That is the 72 base-game medals plus 6 from his two exclusive maps, Freight Train (Combat) and Black Mask (Predator). Joker's Carnival and the Iceberg Lounge maps are not needed.

steps.text: Play Robin on the 24 base-game ranked maps (12 Combat, 12 Predator) and earn 3 medals on each.
Earn 3 medals on Freight Train (Combat) and 3 on Black Mask (Predator).

achievements.description: Obtain 114 medals on the original Arkham City and Robin Bundle Pack campaigns (as Robin)
achievements.summary: Earn 114 medals on Robin's campaigns: the base-game ones plus his Robin Bundle Pack campaign.

guide.context: That is the 108 base-game campaign medals plus 6 from the Black Mask campaign.

steps.text: Play all 12 base-game campaigns as Robin and earn 3 medals on each map.
Play the Black Mask campaign, with Black Mask (Predator) and Freight Train (Combat), and earn all 3 medals on both.

achievements.description: Obtain 78 medals on the original Arkham City and Nightwing Bundle Pack maps (as Nightwing)
achievements.summary: Earn 78 medals on Nightwing's ranked maps: the base-game ones plus his Nightwing Bundle Pack maps.

guide.context: That is the 72 base-game medals plus 6 from his two exclusive maps, Wayne Manor Armory (Combat) and Wayne Manor Main Hall (Predator).

steps.text: Play Nightwing on the 24 base-game ranked maps (12 Combat, 12 Predator) and earn 3 medals on each.
Earn 3 medals on Wayne Manor Armory (Combat) and 3 on Wayne Manor Main Hall (Predator).

achievements.description: Obtain 114 medals on the original Arkham City and Nightwing Bundle Pack campaigns (as Nightwing)
achievements.summary: Earn 114 medals on Nightwing's campaigns: the base-game ones plus his Nightwing Bundle Pack campaign.

guide.context: That is the 108 base-game campaign medals plus 6 from the Wayne Manor campaign. His Predator campaigns are the hardest of any character.

steps.text: Play all 12 base-game campaigns as Nightwing and earn 3 medals on each map.
Play the Wayne Manor campaign, with Wayne Manor Armory (Combat) and Wayne Manor Main Hall (Predator), and earn all 3 medals on both.

achievements.description: No crimefighter should be without this
achievements.summary: Find Batman's discarded Bat-Belt as Robin to finish Episode 1 of Harley Quinn's Revenge.

steps.text: Play Episode 1 of Harley Quinn's Revenge as Robin to the @loc{Warehouse}.
Defeat the Thugs. Robin finds the Bat-Belt, which ends the episode.

achievements.description: Find a way into the secret base
achievements.summary: Hack the Shipyard's Modified Security Console to enter the secret base in Harley Quinn's Revenge.

steps.text: In Episode 2, track GCPD cop Tony Wicker's blood trail to the @loc{Shipyard}.
Collect the three codes for the Modified Security Console.
Use the @item{Cryptographic Sequencer} on the console to get in.

achievements.description: Clean up the Dry Docks
achievements.summary: Defeat Harley Quinn in the Dry Dock.

steps.text: In Episode 3 as Robin, enter the @loc{Dry Dock}.
Take out the Sniper Thug and some Gun Thugs, then beat @enemy{Harley Quinn}. If you corner her, you can keep beating her down with the quarterstaff.

achievements.description: The joke's on who?
achievements.summary: Defeat Harley Quinn and her robots in the final fight of Harley Quinn's Revenge.

steps.text: After the bomb mission, face Harley and her robots in the final confrontation and win.

achievements.description: Zip Kick 5 different thugs
achievements.summary: Zip Kick 5 different Thugs as Robin.

guide.context: You can also earn this in Riddler's Revenge as Robin.

steps.text: Equip Robin's Zip Kick. Use Quickfire Zip Kick (Lt + Y) on each Thug in the first Thug groups in Access Corridor A.
Use it on 2 more Thugs in the next group of four Thugs in Access Corridor A.

achievements.description: Shield Bash 5 different thugs
achievements.summary: Shield Bash 5 different Thugs as Robin.

guide.context: You can also earn this in Riddler's Revenge as Robin.

steps.text: Equip Robin's Bullet Shield. Use Shield Bash (Rt twice) on each Thug in the first group in Access Corridor A.
Use it on 2 more Thugs in the next group of four Thugs.

achievements.description: Snap Flash an unarmed thug, an armed thug, an environmental object and a Titan
achievements.summary: With Robin, use Snap Flash on a Gun Thug, an unarmed Thug, an environmental object and a Titan.

guide.context: All four must be done in the same run of Harley Quinn's Revenge. If you restart the DLC, you must do all four again.

steps.text: Pump Room (Episode 1): Snap Flash an unarmed Thug among the group sealing a door and detonate it.
Access Corridor B (Episode 3): place a Snap Flash on one of the two Gun Thugs and detonate it.

Also in Access Corridor B: crawl through the vent to the small room beside the Sniper Thug. Attach a Snap Flash to a crane hook, move behind the Sniper, then detonate it to knock him over. If you botch it, reload your last save.
Joker Shrine room (end of Episode 3): run up to the @enemy{Titan Thug} and place a Snap Flash, then detonate it.

achievements.description: Defuse all bombs in 3 minutes or less
achievements.summary: Disarm every bomb in Harley Quinn's Revenge within 3 minutes.

guide.context: After the first bomb, a 5-minute timer starts. Finish with more than 2 minutes left. If the clock gets too low, reload your last checkpoint.

steps.text: After rescuing Batman, defuse the nearby bomb to start the timer.
Take Thugs out as fast as possible with Ground and Combat Takedowns. Go to the main room of the @loc{Warehouse} and grapple up to the rafters.
Head to the north end, opposite the Sniper Thug. Take him out first or use a @item{Smoke Pellet}. Block the steaming vents with @item{Freeze Blast} and defuse the second bomb.

In the @loc{Pump Room}, jump onto the platform held by the crane hook at the south end. Shoot the Industrial Motor with @item{Remote Electrical Charge} to slide the platform north. It may take several shots.
Destroy the Structural Weakness in front of you with @item{Explosive Gel} and defuse the final bomb.

achievements.description: Use 5 different Quickfire gadgets in one fight as Robin in Harley Quinn's Revenge
achievements.summary: As Robin in Harley Quinn's Revenge, use five different Quickfire gadgets within a single fight.

guide.context: They can be spread through the fight; they do not have to be in one combo.

steps.text: Use the large Thug group in the center of the @loc{Warehouse} (Episode 1) for the attempt.
In that one fight, use Quickfire Shuriken (Lt), Bullet Shield (Rt Rt), Zip Kick (Lt + Y), Snap Flash (Lt + B) and Explosive Gel (Lt + X).

achievements.description: Destroy all Harley Balloons
achievements.summary: Destroy all 30 Harley Balloons in Harley Quinn's Revenge.

guide.context: The DLC is linear, so you can lose a balloon by moving on. Destroyed balloons stay destroyed across runs of the DLC, so you can replay to finish the rest.

collectibles.name: Harley Balloon #1
collectibles.method: Hit it with a Shuriken. It hangs off the room you just left, up on your left.

collectibles.name: Harley Balloon #2
collectibles.method: On the ceiling by the steel doors at the far east dead end.

collectibles.name: Harley Balloon #3
collectibles.method: In the next room, split by water. Look up and left of the doorway you came through.

collectibles.name: Harley Balloon #4
collectibles.method: Tied to a chair in the open after you deal with the Sniper Thug.

collectibles.name: Harley Balloon #5
collectibles.method: On the iron bars to the left of the doors the Thugs were cutting.

collectibles.name: Harley Balloon #6
collectibles.method: Blast the Structural Weakness at the dead end with Explosive Gel. The balloon is on your left past the trash pool.
collectibles.note: Do not go through the door beside it, or the balloon stays out of reach until you return as Batman.

collectibles.name: Harley Balloon #7
collectibles.method: On the archway in front of the GCPD blockade, right after you speak to Gordon.

collectibles.name: Harley Balloon #8
collectibles.method: In the hands of the left nutcracker at the archway.

collectibles.name: Harley Balloon #9
collectibles.method: Tied to the top of a big smokestack on a wrecked roof patrolled by two Gun Thugs.

collectibles.name: Harley Balloon #10
collectibles.method: At the highest point of the Ferris Wheel.

collectibles.name: Harley Balloon #11
collectibles.method: Glide west from the Ferris Wheel. It is on a loudspeaker in the middle of the roof, with three Gun Thugs.

collectibles.name: Harley Balloon #12
collectibles.method: On a Sniper Thug's tower near the Perimeter Wall, at the end of the line of buildings.

collectibles.name: Harley Balloon #13
collectibles.method: On a nutcracker's hat just past a compound archway.

collectibles.name: Harley Balloon #14
collectibles.method: On a smashed nutcracker propped against a compound wall. Beat the Thugs there first.

collectibles.name: Harley Balloon #15
collectibles.method: From the Steel Mill door, follow the compound wall east. It is near a dumpster.

collectibles.name: Harley Balloon #16
collectibles.method: On the hand of the raised nutcracker reaching down to another nutcracker.

collectibles.name: Harley Balloon #17
collectibles.method: At the top of the highest tower next to the huge chimney.

collectibles.name: Harley Balloon #18
collectibles.method: On an overturned barrel near the middle of the small railway tunnel that runs through the Steel Mill.

collectibles.name: Harley Balloon #19
collectibles.method: Enter from the roof, go down the stairs, and look left. It is on a baby's cradle.

collectibles.name: Harley Balloon #20
collectibles.method: On a spotlight to the right of the hanging cop. Shoot it from the manager's office, or after the Thugs are down.
collectibles.note: Shoot it before you rescue the cop. After the rescue it can no longer be reached.

collectibles.name: Harley Balloon #21
collectibles.method: On the Harley Quinn mannequin standing right of the entrance doors.

collectibles.name: Harley Balloon #22
collectibles.method: Cross the south corridor pools with the Line Launcher. It is on the railing at the top of the stairs in the west room.

collectibles.name: Harley Balloon #23
collectibles.method: Climb the stairs until they break away. Look up at the isolated upper level, near the ceiling.

collectibles.name: Harley Balloon #24
collectibles.method: Take out the six Gun Thugs, but leave the officer tied for now. Look west at ground level, up and right of the exit doors.

collectibles.name: Harley Balloon #25
collectibles.method: Under the walkway, on an open locker.

collectibles.name: Harley Balloon #26
collectibles.method: On crates beside a steaming vent just past the door.

collectibles.name: Harley Balloon #27
collectibles.method: Caught up in the ceiling above the middle of the room.

collectibles.name: Harley Balloon #28
collectibles.method: Behind you when the Sniper Thug pins you down, on a barrel at the dead end.

collectibles.name: Harley Balloon #29
collectibles.method: On top of a disposal bin, just past the open steel doors on your left.

collectibles.name: Harley Balloon #30
collectibles.method: At the far southwest corner, floating on junk in the water before a big tidal grate.
